source_text: β΄. Ὅτι κέκλεισται καὶ ἐσφράγισται ἡ θεία γραφή. δ΄. Περὶ σολοικισμῶν καὶ εὐτελοῦς φράσεως τῆς γραφῆς. ε΄. Τίς ἡ πολυλογία, καὶ τίνα τὰ πολλὰ βιβλία· καὶ ὅτι πᾶσα ἡ θεόπνευστος γραφὴ ἔν βιβλίον ἐστίν.
pass_a_gloss: On the God-breathed character of the divine Scripture, and how one must read and understand it, and what the reason is for the obscurity in it.
pass_b_english: The anthology opens from Origen on the [[God-breathed >> Bible:2 Timothy 3:16]] character of the divine writings and how they are to be read and understood — including why obscurity and passages impossible or absurd at the mere letter are there, so that we seek the Spirit’s sense without despising what the letter rightly carries.
notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
